Author: Rikun
Name: Pizza Referee
Description: In-game referee for the Pizza Challenge. Announces each round, judges every /random against the threshold, moves through each player's pies and the queue, and keeps the night's stats and Hall of Fame. Made for the Bassment; announces in chat on your behalf, so it lives in this custom repository rather than the official list.
Punchline: Runs the Bassment Pizza Challenge: watches /random, calls the rounds, keeps the queue.
